We’ll stand against the devil’s lies;
An army bold, whose battle-cry is Love,
Reaching out to those in darkness.

Our call to war, to love the captive soul
But to rage against the captor;
And with the sword that makes the wounded whole,
We will fight with faith and valour.
When faced with trials on every side
We know the outcome is secure,
And Christ will have the prize for which He died,
An inheritance of nations.

Arise, shine for your light has come
Arise, shine for the Risen Son
Lift your eyes, we are His radiant bride
Arise, o church arise!

Come see the cross, where love and mercy meet,
As the Son of God is stricken;
Then see His foes lie crushed beneath His feet,
For the Conqueror has risen!
And as the stone is rolled away,
And Christ emerges from the grave,
This victory march continues till the day
Every eye and heart shall see Him.

So Spirit, come put strength in every stride,
Give grace for every hurdle,
That we may run with faith to win the prize
Of a servant good and faithful.
As saints of old still line the way,
Retelling triumphs of His grace,
We hear their calls and hunger for the day
When with Christ we stand in glory

title: Sing the wondrous love of Jesus
lyrics:
Sing the wonderous love of Jesus;
sing His mercy and His grace.
In the mansions, bright and blessed,
He'll prepare for us a place.

When we all get to heaven,
what a day of rejoicing that will be!
When we all see Jesus,
We'll sing and shout the victory!

While we walk the pilgrim pathway,
clouds will overspread the sky;
but when trav'ling days are over,
not a shadow, not a sigh!

Let us then be true and faithful,
trusting, serving ev'ry day.
Just one glimpse of Him in glory
will the toils of life repay.

Onward to the prize before us!
Soon His beauty we'll behold.
Soon the pearly gates will open;
we shall tread the streets of gold.

title: Come, thou long expected Jesus
lyrics:
Come, thou long expected Jesus,
born to set thy people free;
from our fears and sins release us,
let us find our rest in thee.
Israel's strength and consolation,
hope of all the earth thou art;
dear desire of every nation,
joy of every longing heart.

Born thy people to deliver,
born a child and yet a King,
born to reign in us forever,
now thy gracious kingdom bring.
By thine own eternal spirit
rule in all our hearts alone;
by thine all sufficient merit,
raise us to thy glorious throne.

title: Another year is dawning
lyrics:
Another year is dawning!
Dear Master, let it be,
In working or in waiting,
Another year with thee.
Another year of leaning
Upon thy loving breast,
Of ever deeper trusting,
Of Quiet, happy rest.

Another year of mercies,
Of faithfulness and grace,
Another year of gladness
Enlightened by thy face.
Another year of progress,
Another year of praise,
Another year of proving
Thy presence all the days.

Another year of service,
Of witness for thy love;
Another year of training
For holier work above.
Another year is dawning!
Dear Master, let it be,
On Earth or else in Heaven,
Another year for thee!

title: Prepare our hearts (Show us Christ)
lyrics:
Prepare our hearts, O God
Help us to receive
Break the hard and stony ground
Help our unbelief
Plant Your Word down deep in us
Cause it to bear fruit
Open up our ears to hear
Lead us in Your truth

Show us Christ, show us Christ
O God, reveal Your glory
Through the preaching of Your Word
Until every heart confesses Christ is Lord

Your Word is living light
Upon our darkened eyes
Guards us through temptations
Makes the simple wise
Your Word is food for famished ones
Freedom for the slave
Riches for the needy soul
Come speak to us today

BRIDGE
Where else can we go, Lord
Where else can we go
You have the words of eternal life

title: But for the cross of Christ
lyrics:
What is the truth that ever anchors me
Amidst the waves of all my guilt
That Christ has shed his blood and pardoned me
At the cross, at the cross
He bore my sin, I bear His righteousness
Oh, what a glorious exchange
The wrath of God laid on the spotless Lamb
Oh, what grace, oh what grace

(Chorus)
Behold the cross, there is no greater love
Haven’s Son, laid down His life for us
Oh, my soul would be lost with no hope to find
But for the cross of Christ 

How do I walk with humble confidence
I look to Christ Who is my peace
He sealed my hope and my inheritance
At the cross, at the cross
When I am weak and stumble into sin
There is an ever-flowing stream
His cleansing blood revives my soul again
Oh, what grace, oh what grace 

One day I’ll stand before the King of Kings
One day I’ll see him face to face
For Jesus rose, death lost its bitter sting
Christ has won! Christ has won!

title: Approach, my soul
lyrics:
Approach, my soul, the mercy seat, 
Where Jesus answers prayer; 
There humbly fall before His feet, 
For none can perish there. 
Thy promise is my only plea, 
With this I venture nigh; 
Thou calls our burdened souls to Thee,
And such, O Lord, am I. 

(Chorus)
Oh wondrous love!
Oh boundless grace! 
Rejoice my soul forever, 
Christ has made a way!

Bowed down beneath a load of sin, 
By Satan sorely pressed,
By wars without, and fears within, 
I come to Thee for rest. 
Be Thou my shield and hiding place,
That, sheltered near Thy side,
I may my fierce accuser face,
And tell him Thou hast died. 

Wondrous love, to bleed and die, 
To bear the cross and shame,
That guilty sinners such as I,
might plead Thy gracious name.
The tempted soul He tells, 'Be still, 
My promised grace receive.'
'Tis Jesus speaks; I must, I will,
I can, I do believe

title: Christ our wisdom
lyrics:
Christ our wisdom, we are humbled
When You hide Your ways from us
You have purposes unnumbered
Each one good and glorious 
Help us trust when we grow weary 
Free us from our anxious thoughts 
Give us grace to see more clearly  
You are God and we are not

Christ our wisdom, be our gladness
When we fail to understand
You ordain all joy and sadness
To fulfil Your perfect plan
Help us know You rule with power
Over every raging flood
In our most uncertain hour 
You are God and we are loved

Christ our wisdom, we will follow
Though the way ahead is veiled
As we journey through the shadows 
Grant us faith where sight has failed 
Help us cling to Your commandments 
Strengthened by Your faithful Word 
We will never be abandoned 
You are God and we are Yours  

Christ our wisdom we adore You
For the beauty of the cross
Once in foolishness we scorned You
But Your blood has ransomed us
Help us sing the endless mercies
Of Your humble heart to save 
Christ our wisdom, Christ our glory
You are God forever praised

title: Hold me saviour
lyrics:
Hold me Savior, lest I wander
Never let me stray 
When my heart is heavy laden 
Help me bear the weight 
May my burden bring me 
Closer to Your side 
Every lack that leads to worship 
Is a precious prize 

(Chorus)
Hold me Savior now and ever 
Lord let Your goodness go with me
Guide and keep me, Gently lead me 
Your presence with me is my peace

Guide me, Savior, let Your nearness,
Cheer me every hour
Show me marvels of Your mercy 
wonders of Your power 
By Your streams of water 
Lead me through this land 
Joys await me on the way
And home is near at hand 

Keep me, Savior, to the finish
Faithful till the end 
When I’ll sing “there never was 
A truer, better friend”
Through the gates of glory 
Lead me all the way 
There my faith will turn to sight
And prayer will turn to praise

title: How firm a foundation
lyrics:
How firm a foundation, ye saints of the Lord,
Is laid for your faith in His excellent word!
What more can He say than to you He hath said,
To you who for refuge to Jesus have fled?

“Fear not, I am with thee, O be not dismayed,
For I am thy God, and will still give thee aid;
I’ll strengthen thee, help thee, and cause thee to stand,
Upheld by My righteous, omnipotent hand.”

“When through the deep waters I call thee to go,
The rivers of sorrow shall not overflow;
For I will be with thee, thy troubles to bless,
And sanctify to thee thy deepest distress.”

“When through fiery trials thy pathway shall lie,
My grace, all sufficient, shall be thy supply;
The flame shall not hurt thee; I only design
Thy dross to consume, and thy gold to refine.”

“E’en down to old age all My people shall prove
My sovereign, eternal, unchangeable love;
And then, when grey hairs shall their temples adorn,
Like lambs they shall still in My bosom be borne.”

“The soul that on Jesus hath leaned for repose,
I will not, I will not desert to his foes;
That soul, though all hell should endeavour to shake,
I’ll never, no, never, no, never forsake!”

title: In the valley
lyrics:
When the path that I feared
Is the way He has set 
And I long to give in and retreat
Still to Jesus I hold as I face every step 
For the Lord He will give me His peace 

(Chorus)
Bless the Lord! He will give me His peace 
Bless the Lord! He will give me His peace 
And if I should remain in the valley today 
Bless the Lord, He will give me His peace 

When the road that I tread 
Fills my heart with despair
And it seems that my grief has no end 
Still to Jesus I hold who will walk with me there 
And the Lord He will give me His strength
(Chorus - Bless the Lord! He will give me his strength..)

On the road that You walked
With the weight of the cross
All my pain and my sorrow You held
So to you I shall hold you redeem every loss
For my Lord, you have given yourself
(Chorus - Bless the Lord! For he gives me Himself..) x2

title: Only a Holy God
lyrics:
Who else commands all the hosts of heaven
Who else could make every king bow down  
Who else can whisper and darkness trembles
Only a Holy God!

What other beauty demands such praises 
What other splendour outshines the sun 
What other majesty rules with justice 
Only a Holy God!

(Chorus)
Come and behold Him
The One and the Only
Cry out, sing holy
Forever a Holy God
Come and worship the Holy God

What other glory consumes like fire 
What other power can raise the dead 
What other name remains undefeated 
Only a Holy God! 

Who else could rescue me from my failing 
Who else would offer His only Son
Who else invites me to call Him Father 
Only a Holy God, only my Holy God!

title: Christus Victor
lyrics:
Amen - 6
O, Most High, King of the ages 
Great I AM, God of wonders 
By the blood You have redeemed us
Led us through mighty waters 
Our strength, our song, our sure salvation 

(Chorus 1)
Now to the Lamb upon the throne 
Be blessing, honor, glory, power
For the battle You have won 
Hallelujah! Amen

O, Most High, dwelling among us
Son of man sent for sinners 
By Your blood You have redeemed us
Spotless Lamb, mighty Savior
Who lived, who died, who rose victorious 

(Chorus 2)
Now to the Lamb upon the throne 
Be blessing, honor, glory, power
For the battle You have won 
Hallelujah! 
With every tribe and every tongue 
We join the anthem of the angels
In the triumph of the Son 
Hallelujah! Amen 

O, Most High, King of the nations 
Robed in praise, crowned with splendour
On that day who will not tremble?
When You stand Christ the Victor
Who was, and is, and is forever

Amen – 3x3 

Sing the victory of the Lamb 
Hallelujah! Amen
Amen - 3

title: Praise the Lord (Ps 150)
lyrics:
You made the starry hosts
You traced the mountain peaks
You paint the evening sky with wonders
The earth, it is Your throne, from desert to the sea
All nature testifies Your splendour

(Chorus 1)
Praise the Lord, praise the Lord
Sing His greatness all creation
Praise the Lord raise your voice
You heights and all you depths
From furthest east to west
Let everything that has breath
Praise the Lord!

You reached into the dust 
In love, Your Spirit breathed
You formed us in Your very likeness
To know Your wondrous works
To tell Your mighty deeds
To join the everlasting chorus 

Let symphonies resound
Let drums and choirs ring out
All heaven hear the sound of worship
Let every nation bring its honours to the King
A roar of harmonies eternal 

(Chorus 2)
Praise the Lord, praise the Lord
Sing His greatness all creation
Praise the Lord raise your voice
You heights and all you depths
From furthest east to west
You distant burning stars 
All creatures near and far 
From sky to sea to shore, sing out forevermore 
Let everything that has breath
Praise the Lord!

title: He will be
lyrics:
God is faithful to His word
Even when there seems no way
Though time may pass His memory will not fade
His promises will never fail

Faithful He has been, faithful He will be
Time and time again, His Word returns complete
To His truth I cling, when the night is deep
Faithful He has been, faithful He will be

God is gracious when I doubt
He draws near though I retreat
Though I may wander through the wilderness
He goes with me and gives me peace

Gracious He has been, gracious He will be
What I don’t deserve, the Father gives to me
Where He leads my feet, I shall not want or need
Gracious He has been, gracious He will be

God is worthy of my song
Countless are His awesome deeds
His mighty hand has parted raging seas
For those He loves, He has redeemed

Worthy He has been, worthy He will be
Crowned in endless praise, all earth and heaven sing
Holy is the Lord who reigns in majesty
Worthy He has been, worthy He will be

BRIDGE
He is my provider, covenant protector
All my hope is in the Lord my God
He is my sustainer, merciful redeemer
All my hope is in the Lord my God (2)

title: He calls me friend
lyrics:
I have a friend, a faithful friend 
And Jesus is His name 
He will not leave, He stands by me 
My Shepherd He remains 
I have a friend, a mighty friend 
And Jesus is His name
I shall not fear, He holds me near
His strength will keep me safe 

His name is True King Lord of creation 
Ruler without end 
I call Him Hope, Peace, Wonderful Saviour 
And what joy that Jesus calls me friend!

I have a friend, the kindest friend
And Jesus is His name
He hears my cry, by day or night
And wipes my tears away 

I have a friend, a Saviour friend 
And Jesus is His name 
He fought for me on Calvary 
And trampled on the grave!

title: I will wait for you (Ps 130)
lyrics:
Out of the depths I cry to You
In darkest places I will call
Incline Your ear to me anew
And hear my cry for mercy, Lord
Were You to count my sinful ways
How could I come before Your throne
Yet full forgiveness meets my gaze
I stand redeemed by grace alone

I will wait for You, I will wait for You
On Your word, I will rely
I will wait for You, surely wait for You
Till my soul is satisfied

So put your hope in God alone
Take courage in His power to save
Completely and forever won
By Christ emerging from the grave
Now He has come to make a way
And God Himself has paid the price
That all who trust in Him today
Find healing in His sacrifice

I will wait for You, I will wait for You
Through the storm and through the night
I will wait for You, surely wait for You
For Your love is my delight

title: Keyah hey tere gavah he
lyrics:
Keyah hey tere gavah he
NA

title: Hey dhuniya ke logon
lyrics:
Hei duniya ke looghon, 
Oonchi aawaz karon
Gawoon khushi ke geeth
Usuka gunugaan karo
Ibadahat karo usuki ibadat karo -2

Yaadhu rakh-ko ke vahi ye-ku khudaa hey
Hum ko ye jeevan ussee..ne diya hey
Usssu chaaragahaa se hum-sabu-hein aaye
Hum dho sanaa ke humugeet gaaye
Rabu ka thumu shu ka-ru karo
Oonchi aawaz karo
Gawon khushi ke geeth
Usuka gunugaan karo
Ibadahat karo usuki ibadat karo -2

Naamey Khudawand, kithu na mubaaraku
Mera Khudaawand kithu na bahlaa hein
Rehay mathu-hay usuki sadiyoon purani
Wafa ka azal se yahi silsila hey
Usu paru eemanu dharo, 
Uske ghar aapu chalo
Gawon khushi kay geeth
Usuka gunugaan karo
Ibadat karo uski Ibadat karo -2

O people of the world,
Lift up your voice
And sing the songs of joy
Declare praises of Him
Worship Him, Worship…

Remember that He alone is God
It is He who has given us this life
We all have come from that (spring)
Let’s sing the song of His praise
Give thanks to the Lord
Lift up your voice
And sing the songs of joy
Declare praises of Him 
Worship Him, Worship…

How blessed is the Name of the Lord!
My God, How good is He!
His compassion is from ageless past
From endless faithfulness this history rolls on
Cast your faith on Him, 
Walk yourself to His house!
And sing the songs of joy
Declare praises of Him
Worship Him, Worship…

title: Bharpoor jeevan
lyrics:
Bharpoor jeevan, tere liye -2
Yeshu laaya hai, tere liye -2

Jeevan se thak kar, hai kyu udaas
Yeshu hai deta, jeevan mein aas (2)
Anandh jeevan, tere liye -2
Yeshu laaya hai, tere liye -2

Khali hai jeevan tera, hai bae karaar
Taras kha kar Yeshu tujhpar, karta hai pyaar (2)
Jharoonoo sa jeevan, tere liye -2
Yeshu laaya hai, tere liye -2

Abundant life for you
Jesus brought it for you

Being tired from this life, why are you so sad?
Jesus gives new hope in life
A joyful life for you
Jesus brought it for you

Your life is empty and there is no rest
Jesus will have mercy on you and will love you
A life like an overflowing waterfall is for you
Jesus brought it for you

title: Yeh dhara aasman
lyrics:
Yeh dhara aasman
Sab hai Tere gawah
Aye Masih aye Masih
Anoki Teri daastha (2)

Mera rok rom hai Tera rini
Tu mera charwahaa hai mujhko kya ghati
Thu ne jo kuch ghavaya yaha
Wo kaha tujhe chukkayaa gaya
Mera dil, meri jaan
Mera tan mera mann
Mere Yeshu ki sthuthi kare (2)

Thu dhaya ki ek misaal hai Prabhu
Kam se kam mein Tera saaya ban saku
Thu pyaar aur shama ka saagar, Prabhu
Mein Tere saagar ki boondhu ban saku
Yeh hai meri dua
Yeh hai meri aarzoo
Yeh meri kaamna hai hardham Prabhu (2)

Socho kithna pyar kartha hai hu’me
Pucho kithna pyar kartha hai hu’me
Apne hothon se wo kuchna bolega
Tumko dekh kar yu muskurayega
Apne baahe faelakar
Krus pae jaan Usne dhi
Aur kaha Mujhko ithna pyar hai (2)

This Earth and Heavens
All are Your witnesses
O Christ O Christ
Wondrous is Your story

My every bit is indebted to You
You are my shepherd I lack nothing
What You have sacrificed
Could never be paid off
My heart and my soul
My body and my heart
Will praise my Lord Christ

Lord, You are unmatched example of mercy
Atleast if I could be the shadow of You
You are an ocean of love and forgiveness, Lord
If I could be a drop of that ocean
This is my prayer
This is my hope
This is my desire forever Lord

Think on how much He loves us
Ask how much He loves us?
He will not utter a word from His mouth
He will look at you and smile
With His arms spread wide
He gave His life on the cross
And said, “This much I love you”

title: Karte hai Teri hum stuthi
lyrics:
Karte hai Teri hum stuthi,
Hridai ki geharaiiyo se (2)
Yeshu Tu he hai Tu he hai
Humara Prabhu (2)
Mahima ho Teri, Mahima ho Teri -2

Aatma or sacchai se
Teri aaradhna kare (2)
Ooncha aur ooncha
Sabse ooncha rahe Tera Naam (2)
Mahima ho teri (2)

title: Pahadon ki taraf
lyrics:
Pahadon ki taraf nazar uttaunga -2
Meri sahayatha kahan se aayegi -2
Jisne aasman aur zameen banayi hai
Usi khuda ko maine madathgar paaya hai
Madath wahi se meitho paaunga -2

Phisalne na dega tere paav ko kabhi
Oonghne ka nahi mohafis tera kabhi (2)
Woh kabhi na oongega, woh kabi na soega
Dhekho Israayel ka rakshak hai Khudha -2
Madath uni se maitho paaunga -2

Sun le muhafis tera Prabhu Yehovah hai
Tere dhahiney hath mein tera sayeh bandh hai (2)
Naaa aap thaab din ko, naaa maaha thaab raat ko
Tujhko nah kabhi yeh sathayenghe
Har bhala se Khuda hi bachayenge
Aane jaane mei bachayenge
Humko yaki hai bachayenge

title: Aek aagh har dil may
lyrics:
Ek aag har dil mei
Humko jalaana hei
Bhatke hue jeevan
Prabhu se milaana hei

Sansaar ki aasha bhari
Nazarein hum hi par hein
Uddhar ka sandesh bhi
Kaandho ke upar hei (2)
Ek deep se laakhon diye
Humko jalaana hei (2)

Itne saral ye raste
Kal na khule honge
Prachaar ke awasar hamein 
Phir na mile honge (2)
Taiyaar rahana kal hamein
Khud ko mitaana hei (2)

title: Halleluiah Stuthi Gayaem hum
lyrics:
Halleluyah stuti gaye ham
Yeeshu ki stuti gaye ham (2)
Haa Halleluyah Halleluyah Halleluyah -2 

Kroos par bali dwara
Apna lahu bahaya (2)
Paap ko hattakar
Saaf hamein kiya
Hamko bachha liya (2)

Is jeevan bhar me
Saada Tujhko dhayan karunga (2)
Teri aatma paake
Teri ichhaa jaan ke
Aage hi badhta rahunga (2)

Yeeshu ke pas aao
Aur mukti ko apnao (2)
Ashish Wo dega
Saath apne lega
Kabhi nahi chodega (2)

title: Yehova Yireh
lyrics:
Yehovah Yireh, mera Thu dhatha
Thu mujuko kaafi hey
Yehovah Rapha, changa karne wala
Tere maarkhane se may swathandhru
Yehovah Shamma, Thu mere saath hey
Meri ghati puuri karega

Thu bhar kaafi hey -3
Mujuko

Yehovah Elohim, shrishti karne wala
Apne vachan se sabh kuch banaya
Yehovah Eliyon, param pradhan Thu 
Tere samaan aur koi nahi
Yehovah Shalom, Thu meri shanthi
Dhega voh shaanthi thum hey

title: Aey jeevan ke rahi
lyrics:
Aey jeevan ke rahi, kis raah par thu chala ?
Nashu ke raahu ya jeevan ke marge pe ..
Manzil teri kya bata ?

Awaaz… kya tu, sunta… yeeshu ka
Wo tujhe bula raha ...
Loutkar ..sansaar ke, andhakar… mein math ja
Bauthick sukh hai bas maaya

Yeeshu… ka premu jo prakat hai..
Kya tu.. mehsoos bhi kar naa sake ?
Koi bhi shakti ya koi vipatti ho
Saath na chode wo tera ..kabhi ..

Aey jeevan ke rahi, kis raah par thu chala ?
Nash ke raah ya jeevan ke marge pe ..
Manzil teri kya bata ?

title: Jo Kroos pe kurbaan hai
lyrics:
Jo krus pe kurban hai
Vo mera Masiha hai
Har zakm jo Usuka hai
Vo mere gunaah kaa hai -2

The One who was sacrificed on cross
Was my Messiah
Every wound He has
Is because of my sins

Is duniya mein le aaye
Mere hi gunaah Usko -2
Ye zulm sitam us par
Maine hi karaya hai -2

My sins have brought Him to this world
I only have caused all these affliction

Insaan hai vo kabil
Aur sachha Khudha vo hai -2
Vo pyar ka dhariya hai
Sachhai ka rastha ha -2

He alone is the able and true
He is abounding in love and true way

Dene ko mujhe jeewan, Khud maut sahi Usne
Kya khoob hai kurbaani,
Kya pyaar anokha hai

To give me life,
He took upon death
Such great is the sacrifice
The love so unique

title: Ho Teri Stuthi
lyrics:
Ho Teri stuti aur aradhana
Karta hu mein Tujhse yeh prarthana
Mahima se Teri Tu is jagah ko bhar
Jo bhi Tu chahe, Tu yahan par kar
Hale-hallelujah-hallelujah-hallelu -2

Let You be praised and worshiped
This is my prayer unto You
Let this place be filled with Your glory
And let Your desire be done here
Hallelujah

Karuna se Teri naya din dikhata hai
Dhal banker meri mujhe bachata hai
Jab main pukaru Tu daude aata hai
Jab main giru, mujhe uthata hai
Hale-hallelujah-hallelujah-hallelu -2

Out of Your grace You give us each new day
You protect me like a shield
When I call You come hasting
When I fall You’re there to hold me
Hallelujah

Sare jahan mein Tujhsa koi nahi
Tujhko chod koyi Prabhu hai hi nahi
Ghutne main teku bas Tere saamne
Tu hai mera Prabhu Tu mera Pita
Hale-hallelujah-hallelujah-hallelu -2

There is none like You in the whole world
There is no God apart from You
I’ll kneel down before You alone
You are my God and my Father
Hallelujah

title: Senao ka Yehova
lyrics:
Senao ka Yahowa hama’re sang sang hei
Yakub ka Parmeshwar hamara ooncha gadh hei

The LORD of hosts is with us
God of Jacob is our fortress

Jiss’ne aakash banaaya
Jiss’ne prithwi banaayi
Jo sarva shaktiimaan Prabhu hei
Woh Yahowa hama’re sang sang hei

He who created the sky
He who made the earth
He is the Almighty Lord
He is the One with us

Samudra ko jis’ne dhobhagga
Janggal’se marghei nikaala
Jo waai’de ko kartha hei poora
Woh Yahowa hama’re sang sang hei

He divided the seas
He made a way in the wilderness
He who fulfills His promises
He is the One with us

Laazar ko jiss’ne jilaaya
Zakkai ko jis’ne bachaya
Jiske li’ye sabkuch sambhav hei
Woh Yahowa hama’re sang sang hei

He who raised Lazarus
He who saved Zacchaeus
For Whom all things are possible
He is the One with us

title: Aaadi aur anth Tu hi hai
lyrics:
Aadi aur aanth Tu hi hain
Alpha aur Omega Tu hi hain,
Duton ki stuthi bhi Tu hi hain
Buddhi aur sab gyan Tu hi hain (2)

You are the beginning and the end
You are the Alpha and the Omega
You are the One that angels praise
You are the knowledge and wisdom

Yeshu Tu mahan hain, Yeshu Tu acha hain,
Yeshu Tu zinda hain, Yeshu Tu dhanya hain
Duton ki stuthi bhi Tu hi hain
Buddhi aur sab gyan Tu hi hain
Rajawon ka Raja Tu hi hain
Prabhwon ka Prabhu Tu hi hain

Jesus You are great, Jesus You are good
Jesus You are alive, Jesus You are blessed
You are the One that angels praise
You are the knowledge and wisdom
You are the King of kings
You are Lord of the lords

Jeevan mera paap se bhara
Jag andhera aur ashudh saara
Mere paapon se bachane ko,
Mere liye jeevan diya hain (2)

My life was full of sin
And my world was dark and unholy
To save me from my sins,
You gave Your life

Saare gunaahgaron ke liye,
Apna khoon bahaya Yeshu ne
Khaayi kodon ki maar bhi,
De saleeb par Usne Apni jaan (2)

For all sinners,
Jesus shed His blood
He was flogged too,
Gave His life on the cross

Vaada kiya hai Thune,
Vaada Thu poora karta hain
Vaade ke liye aathe hain,
Barkaton ki barish abudel (2)

You give promise and
You fulfill the promise
We come for promises,
Pour out showers of blessings

Nyaya karne aane wala hain,
Nyaya ke saath rajya karne ko
Dharmiyon ko lekar nyayy se,
Simhaasan par rajya karega (2)

You are coming to judge,
You will reign with justice
To justify the righteous,
You will reign on Your throne

title: Yehova charwaha mera
lyrics:
Yehowah charwaha mera, koi ghati mujhe nahin hain
Hari charayiyon mein mujhe, sneh se chalata wo hain

The Lord is my shepherd and I shall not want
He leads me affectionately among green pastures

Mruthyu ke andhhakar se, mein jo jatha tha
Prabhu Yeshu karuna se, tasalli mujhe di hain (2)

While I was passing though the darkness of death
Graciously, Lord Jesus has comforted me

Shatruvon ke saaamne, mez ko bichaata hain
Prabhu ne jo taiyyar kee, mann mera magan hain (2)

You prepare a table in the presence of enemies
My heart rejoices for what the Lord has prepared

Sir par jo tel mala hain, abhishek mujhe kiya hain
Dil mera bhar gaya hain, aur umad bhi raha hain (2)

You poured oil over my head and anointed me
My heart is full and is even overflowing.

Sarvada Prabhu ghar mein, karoonga nivas jo mein
Karuna bhalayi uski, aanandit mujhe karti hain (2)

I will dwell in the house of the Lord forever
His mercy and goodness make me joyful

title: Hey swargiya Pita
lyrics:
He Swargiya Pita, Tere naam ki stuti ho
He Jeevandata, Tere Sanmukh aate hum (2)
Aaradhana, Ho, Aaradhana -2

Oh, Heavenly Father, let Your name be praised
Oh, giver of Life, we come before You
We adore You

Tere siva koi nahi, aaradhana ke yogya
Tere saman koi nahi, swarg mein, ya purthvi mein (2)
Aaradhana, Ho, Aaradhana -2

There is none worthy of worship than You
No one can be compared to You neither in Heaven or Earth
We adore You

title: Neele aasman ke paar jaayenge
lyrics:
Neele aasman ke paar jayenge,
Mera Yeshu rahta vaha’n (2)
Ham milenge, badalo’n par -2
Dekhenga saara jaha’n (2)

We’ll go beyond the blue sky,
My Jesus lives there
We’ll meet over the clouds
The world will witness

Uska koi bhi wada, na hotha adhura,
Har ek wada uska, hota hei pura (Uska, koi bhi wada)
Uske aane ka wada, bhi pura hoga,
Dekhega saara jaha’n (2)

None of His promises are unfulfilled
He fulfills all of his promises
His promise of Coming again will also be fulfilled
And the world will witness

Yeh vishwas hei mera, jo hoga pura
Sapna ye mera na rahega adhura (Yeh vishwas hei mera)
Tere sang ham rahenge, apne Yeshu ke
Dekhega saara jaha’n (2)

The belief of mine which is going to be fulfilled
This dream of mine will not remain unfulfilled
Will be with our Jesus forever
The world will witness

title: Rahon mei kaante agar ho
lyrics:
Rahon mein kaante agar ho,
Rukna nahi chalte jana
Yeshu tere sath hai,
Ye tu vishwas karna
Sansaar ke anth tak,
Woh tere saath hai

If there are thorns on the way,
Do not stop but keep going on
Jesus is with you,
This you must believe
Even till the end of this age
He is with you

Aandhi aane do, ya aane do toofan -2
Wo naiyya kya doobegi, jis mein hai Yeshu mahan

Let there be a windstorm or a cyclone
The ship that has Jesus will not sink

Dukh se bhari hai zindagi,
Musibat bhare raastein hain -2
Dukh dur ho jaenge tere
Agar tu Yeshu ke saath hai

Life is filled with sorrows,
There are roads full of trouble
Your sorrows will go far away,
If Jesus is with you

Agar maut ka dar sataye tujhe,
Saleeb per tu gaur kar -2
Yeshu ne maut ko jeet liya hai
Us par tu vishwas kar

If the fear of death is troubling you,
Then meditate on the cross.
Jesus has won over death,
Believe in Him

title: Aaya Masih duniya me Tu
lyrics:
Aaya Masih, duniya mein Tu,
Papiyo ko, bachane ko
Laye iman, jo Bete par
Karega paar is duniya ko

Christ You came into this world
To save sinners
Whoever believes in Son
Will be saved from this world

Duniya gunaho mein doob rahi thi,
Saadik gumrah, ho rahe the
Chhoda aasman, bana insaan,
Mili najaat, is duniya ko

The world is sinking in sins
And all of them are being misdirected
You left Heaven, became man
And this world received salvation

Betleham ke, maidano mein
Gadariye raat, so rahe the,
Suna farishto, ki zuban
Paida hua, hai krist nidhaan

In the fields of Bethlehem,
Shepherds lay in the night
Heard the praises of the angels
That Christ was born

Aalimo ne, kitabo mein
Padi paida-ish ki tafseel,
Chal diye wo, bhi oonto par,
Tare hayaat, ka peecha kar

Wise men read in the books
About the birth in great detail
They too went on the camels
Following the star

title: Yeshu Masih
lyrics:
Yeshu Masih Tere jaisa hai koi nahi
Tere charano mein jhuke aasman
Aur mahima gaaye sabhi

Jesus no one is like you
Heavens bow down at your feet
And we all sing your glory

Hum gaaye hosanna, Tu Rajaon ka hai Raja
Teri mahima hove sada
Tu hai Prabhu hamara Khuda

We sing hosana, You are the king of kings
May you be glorified forever
You, oh Lord, are our god

Pyare Pita Tune humse kitna pyar Kiya
Humme papo se chudane ko
Apne Bete ko kurban Kiya

Loving father you loved us so much
That, to free sins us from our sins
You sacrificed your own son for us

title: Mukthi dilaye Yeshu naam
lyrics:
Mukti dilaye Yeshu naam
Shanti dilaye Yeshu naam (2)

Yeshu daya ka behta sagar -2
Yeshu hai data mahan -2

Charni main tooney janamliya Yeshu -2
Sooley pay kiya vishram -2

Ham sab key papon ko mitane -2
Yeshu hua hai balidaan -2

Krus par apna khoon bahaa kar -2
Sara chukaya daam -2

title: Yeshu ne apna khoon
lyrics:
Yeshu ne apna khoon, baha ke mujhe bacha liya
Kyu main na gaonga, gun usi ke mujhe bacha liya (2)

Jesus shed His own blood and saved me
Will I not sing about His goodness, He saved me

Jab main gunaoh mein pada hua tha
Yeshu aa gaya
Ussi ke mare jaane se main
Jeevan bhi paa gaya (2)
Esiliye gaonga gun usi ke mujhe bacha liya
Yeshu ne apna khoon, baha ke mujhe bacha liya

When I was fallen in my sins
Jesus came
Only by His being crucified
I was given life
So, I will sing of His goodness, He saved me
Jesus shed His own blood and saved me

Mere gunaoh ka bhoj uttha kar
Kya kya na usne sahaa
Mere gunaoh ko maaf karane
Khoon bhi uska baha (2)
Kitna anokha hai pyar masih ka
Mujhe bacha liya
Yeshu ne apna khoon, baha ke mujhe bacha liya

He lifted the burden of my sins
What all He had to suffer
To pardon my sins
His blood was shed
How marvelous is the Saviour’s love
That saved me
Jesus shed His own blood and saved me

title: Dhanyawaad ke saath
lyrics:
Dhanyawad ke saath stuti gaoonga 
Hey Yeeshu mere Khuda 
Upkaar Tere hain beshumaar 
Koti koti stuti dhanyawad 

With thanks giving I will sing praises
O Jesus my God
Your favors towards me are so many
A million thanks to You

Yogyata se badke diya hai 
Apni daya se Tune mujhe (2)
Mangne se zyaada mila mujhe 
Aabhaari hun Prabhu mai (2)

You have given me more than I am worthy of
By Your mercies towards me
I have received more than I asked for
I am thankful Lord

Tu hai sacha zinda khuda 
Tujh par hi bharosa mera (2)
Seva poori karke paoon inaam 
Prabhu aisa do vardaan (2)

You are the true living God
I have trust in you alone
I may finish my work and receive my reward
Lord grant me this desire

title: Karta hu Main teri chintha
lyrics:
Karta hu Mei teri chintha
Tu kyon chintha karta hai (2)
Aasuon ki ghaṭio mein
Haath na choḍunga tera (2)

I care for you,
Why do you worry
Through the valley of tears
I will not leave your hand

Meri mahima tu dekhega
Khud ko mere hathon mein de de (2)
Meri shakti Mei tujhko deta hu
Chalaooṅga hardin meri kripa mein (2)

You will see my glory,
Give yourself to me
I give you my strength
I will lead you every day of your life

Sabhi tujh ko bhuleṅge tho bhi
Kya Mei tujhko bhuluṅga kabhi (2)
Apne haathon mein tujhe uṭhakar
Chalaunga har din, isi jahan mein (2)

Even if everyone forgets you,
Will I ever forget you?
I will lift you up in my hands,
I will lead you every day in this world

Abraham ka Mei Parmeshwar hoon
Adbhut karya kyu na karunga (2)
Lal sagar me rasta diya
Aaj bhi Mei karne ke yogya hoo (2)

I am the God of Abraham
Why will I not do wonderful deeds?
I made the way through Red Sea
I am able to do great things even today

title: Aaj ka dhin Yehova ne banaya hai
lyrics:
Aaj ka din Yehovah ne banaya hai
Hum is mai aanandhith ho, 
aanandhith ho (2)

This is the day that the Lord has made
We will rejoice and be glad in it.

Prabhu ko mahima mile, 
Chahe ho mera apmaan(2)
Wah badhe mai ghatu,
Rahe isi ka dhyaan(2)
Aaj ka din..(2)

May God be glorified through me, 
Even if it brings defame,
May He increase and I decrease, 
May this be always on my mind

Stuti Prashansa kare,
Kyo na kuch hotha rahe (2)
Usko hum bhate rahe,
Chahe jaha bhi rahe (2)
Aaj ka din..(2)

(We ) praise and give thanks, 
Irrespective of whatever happens 
We may be pleasing to Him,
No matter where we are

Aatha hu Tere paas,
Mujh ko hai Tujh se aas (2)
Mujh ko Kabul kar le,
Paapo se shudh kar de (2)
Aaj ka din..(2)

I  come to You, 
I have hope in you,
Accept me (o Lord),
Cleanse me from (my) sin

title: Vandana karte hain hum
lyrics:
Vandana karte hai hum(4)
Hriday ko tere saamne
Laakar rakhte hai hum
Vandana karte hai hum(4)

We glorify (You 
We bring our hearts before you
We glorify(You)

Hriday mei mere Masihaa…
Jeevan deep jala…(2)
Hridaya ke paapon ko dhokar
prem ki raah dikha…(2)

Christ is in my heart...
A light of life is lit
By washing away the sins of my heart
Show me the way of love

Mei hoon nirbal maanav…
Paapon ke saagar mei khoya...(2)
Ab tum sambhalo Yeshuji
Bhav saagar mei hoon khoya..(2)

I am a man without strength...
I am lost in the sea of sin
Oh Jesus uphold me now
I am lost in the sea of this world

Shakti de de mujhko…
Mera nahi koi meet..(2)
Jeevan ko mere le lo
Gaaoon mei tere hi geet (2)

Give me power( or strength)
I have no friend
Take my life
I sing of you alone

title: Yeshu hai meri panah
lyrics:
Yeshu hai meri panah
Wo hi hai meri chatthaan;
Langar mein daaltha usme
Jis wakhth aa gherthe toofan (2)

Neevunte naku chalu yesayya
Nee vente nenu unta nesayya   
Nee maata chaalayya, nee choopu chaalayya
Neethodu chaalayya, 
Nee needa chaalayya         

1) Enni baadhalunnanu  ibbandulainanoo
Enta kashtamochina nishturamainanu                                                                               

2) Bratuku naava pagilinaa - adaviaalainanu
Alalu munchi vesinaa - aashaluanagaarinaa

3)Aaastulanni poyinaa - AnaadhagaaMigilinaa     
Aaaptule vidanadinaa - aarogyamksheeninchina    

4)Neeku ilalo ediyu - ledu asaadhyamu
Needu krupato naakediyu - naakilasamaanamu

title: Nee prema nee karuna
lyrics:
Nee prema nee karuna
Chalunaya na jeevithana
Mari denini ashinchanu
Ne koranu ee jagana

Chalayya chalu ee devanalu chalu
Melayya melu nee sannidhi melu

Guri leni nannu gurthinchi nave
Enaleni premanu chupinchi nave
Velaleni naku viluvichinave
Viluvaina patraga nanu marchinave

Chey jarina nakai che jachi nave
Chedarina na brathukunu chaera deesinave
Chera nundi nannu vidipinchi nave
Cheragani ne pramaku sakshiga marchave

Narakapu polimeralo nanu kanugonnave
Kaluvarilo prana michi nanu konnave
Nee premanu prakatimpa nanu ennukonnave
Nee kumaruniga nanu marchinave
Aradhana aradhana

title: Preminchedhan adhigamuga
lyrics:
Preminchedan Adhikamuga
Aaradhinthun Aasakthitho(2)
Purna manasutho Aaradhinthun
Purna balamutho preminchedhan 
Aaradhana aaradhana(4)

Let us love Exceedingly
Worship him with great desire
Worship him with all of your heart
Love him with all of your strength
Worship Him Worship Him

1.Ebinezere Ebinezere  
Entha varaku Adukunnavu
Nannu entha varaku Adukunnavu 
Ninnu purna manasutho Aaradhinthun
Purna balamutho preminchedhan
Aaradhana aaradhana(4)

Ebenezer Ebenezer
Thus far your have protected us
Worship him with all of your heart
Love him with all of your strength
Worship Him Worship Him

2.Elrohi Elrohi
Nannu chuchave Vandhanamaya (2)
Ninnu purna manasutho Aaradhinthun
Purna balamutho preminchedhan 
Aaradhana aaradhana(4)

Elohim, Elohim
Thankyou for having mercy on me
Worship him with all of your heart
Love him with all of your strength
Worship Him Worship Him

3. Yehova Rapha Yehova Rapha 
Swasthaparchave Vandanamaya
Nannu swasthaparchave Vandhanamaya
Ninnu purna manasutho Aaradhinthun
Purna balamutho preminchedhan
Aaradhana aaradhana(4)

Jehovah Rapha Jehovah Rapha
Thankyou for healing me
Worship him with all of your heart
Love him with all of your strength
Worship Him Worship Him

title: Parishuddha Parishuddha
lyrics:
Parishuddha (3) Prabhuva
Varadutha-lainanin varnimpagalaraa
Varadutha-lainanin (3) varnimpagalaraa

Parishuddha jenakuda para-maathma roopuda
Nirupama bala-buddhi neethi prabhavaa
Nirupama bala-buddhi (3) neethi prabhavaa

Parishuddha Thanayuda nara roopa dharuda
Naru-laanu raakshinchu karunaa Samudra
Naru-laanu raakshinchu (3) karunaa Samudra

Parishuddha magu naathma vara mu-lidu nathma
Para-maananda prema Bhakhtula kidumaa
Para-maananda prema (3) Bhakhtula kidumaa

Jenaka Kumaraathma lanu neka deva
Ghana mahima chellunu dhanara nithyamugaa
Ghana mahima chellunu (3) dhanara nithyamugaa

title: Vivaaaahamannadi pavitramainadi
lyrics:
Vivaaaahamannadi pavitramainadi 
ganudaaaina deeevudu eerparaachinadi (2)

Dehamulosaga bagamuga
Manugadalosaha charininiga (2)
Naariga sahakaaariga  
Streninirrminchinaaadu devudu (2)
                                                                
Vantari gaaunndaraadani 
Jantagaaa undameeelani (2)
Silasugaaa nilavaalani 
Purushuni niyaaaminchiinadu devudu (2)
                                                                    
Devulikiii athi priyuluga 
Phalamulatho vridhi pondaga (2)
Vaeeruga nunnaavaaarini 
okatiga ilaa chesinaadu devudu (2)

title: Sudhinam sarva janulaku
lyrics:
Sudinam sarvajanulaku
Samadhanam sarva jagathiki (2)
Prabu Yesuni jananamanadu
Vikasimchenu madini nedu (2)

A good day for everyone,
Peace for all the world
On the occasion of Jesus’s birth
Blooming on every mind

Chikati maranam bula mayam
Ee manava jivitha margam (2)
Paramuku padhamai arudhinche
Velugai Yesudu udayinche (2)

Darkness and fear of death filled
The life of humans
Marching towards Heaven
Like a light Jesus has risen

Kanneetitho nindina kanulanu
Yidumulan annitini tuduvanu (2)
Udayinchenu kanthiganadu
Virajimmenu shanthini nedu (2)

Eyes which were filled with tears
And difficulties, were wiped off
Risen like a Light
He showers peace today

Vachchenu naruduga aanadu
Thechchenu rakshana aanade (2)
Tvaralo vachchunu aaredu
Sthirapaduma ika yinadu (2)

One day He came like a man
And brought salvation on that day
This King is coming soon
So be prepared today

title: Devudu lokamunu
lyrics:
Devudu lokamunu entho preminchenu -2
Ninnu nannu daralo prathivarini -2
Entho preminchenu, preminchi yethenchenu
 
Paraloka prema ee-dharalo
Prathyakshamaye prthivarikai (2)
Aadhiyendunna aah Devudu
Yethinche narudai eebhuvikee (2)
Ee-prema nee korakai
Jenminche iela Yesu nee korakai (2)

Papandha karamulo andhuniga
Cheekati throvalo thirugaadaga (2)
Jeevapu velugaina aah prabhuvu
Velinginchaga vachanu prathivarinee (2)
Ee-velugu nee korakai
Yesu ninnala velinginchenu (2)

title: Shresta maina Naamam
lyrics:
Shresta maina Naamam, shakthikaligina Naamam
Junte th’e’ne dharala kanna, madhuramaina Naamam 
Saatilaeni Naamam, swasthapariche Naamam
Anni Naamamula kanna, nithya maina Naamam

Most excellent Name, Name with Power
Than dripping honey, Name that is sweeter
Incomparable name, Name that can heal
Among all names, everlasting Name

Yesu Naamam, madhura Naamam
Yesu Naamam sumadhura Naamam 
 
Name of Jesus is a sweet Name
Name of Jesus is the sweetest Name

Throva chuupi sariyaina dharilo,
Nannu nadipinche Naamam
Dushta shakthulu bandhagamulu, tholaginche Naamam
Tharamulenno maarinaa, manushulentha maarinaa -2
Maarani Naamam, mahima Naamam
Maranamu gelichana sreeyesu Naamam

Showing the path in right direction, 
The Name that leads me
The Name that keeps me from all evil
Even though ages pass by, or people around us change
Unchanging Name, glorious Name 
The Name of Jesus who won over death

Jeevithamantha jeevanamantha, smarinchakalegae Naamam
Kalavaramulanu ventadinanu, 
Dhairiyamuniche Prabhu Naamam
Bhadhalentho unnanu, shanthi nosagaey dhivya Naamam -2
Maarani Naamam, mahima Naamam
Maranamu gelichana sreeyesu Naamam

All of my life is not enough to ponder over His Name 
Through the troubles, 
The Lord’s Name provides boldness
Though there are worries, the mighty name provides peace
Unchanging Name, glorious Name
The Name of Jesus who won over death

title: Preminchaavu nannu poshinchaavu
lyrics:
Preminchaavu nannu poshinchaavu
Naakai siluva pai pranam ichaavu
Naakai siluvapai baadha nondhaavu
Naakai siluvapai raktha michaavu (2)

You loved and provided for me
And You died on the cross for me
You are wounded on the cross for me
You shed Your blood on the cross for me

Naa thalampulanu ba’te Nee thalakku mullu
N’e chesina hathyalake Nee chethula mekulu (2)
Paapini aadharinchaavu
Naa siluva Nee veepu pai mosavu

Because of my thought, thorns are on Your head
And the nails on Your hands are for all the murder that I did
You embraced a sinner like me
And carried my cross on Your back

Naa kalla nadakkala kai Nee kaalaku seelalu
Ne chesina paapamukae Nee prakkana bhallemu (2)
Paapini karunachoopavu
Naa siluva Nee bhujamu pai mosavu

The nails on Your leg are for my wretched ways
And the spear on Your side was for my sins
You had mercy on sinner like me
And carried my cross on Your shoulder

title: Naa jeevam, naa sarvam
lyrics:
Naa jeevam, naa sarvam Neeve Devaa
Naa korake bali aina gorrepilla
Naa korake raanunna O Messayya

My life and my everything is You Lord
You are the Lamb that was sacrificed for me
And the Messiah Who has come for me

Thappipoyina nannu, vedaki rakshinchi
Manchi kaaparivai
Naakai Praanamichchithivi (2)
Emivvagalanu Nee enaleni premakai
Virigi naligina hrudayame nenarpinthunu

You found me when I was lost
You are the good shepherd
Who gave His life for me
What can I give You back for Your love
My broken and contrite heart, I offer to You

title: Enduko nanninthaga neevu
lyrics:
Enduko nanninthaga Neevu, preminchithivo Deva
Anduko naa deena stuthi paatra 
Hallelujah Yesayya (2)

Why did You love me so much, my Lord
Please accept my thanksgiving
Hallelujah Jesus

Naa paapamu baapa nararupivainavu
Naa shaapamu maapa naligi vreladithivi
Naaku chaalina Devudavu Neeve 
Naa sthaanamulo Neeve
Halleluyah Yesayya 

You became man, because of my sin
You were cursed because of my curse
You are enough for me O Lord
For You took my place
Hallelujah Jesus

Nee rupamu naalo nirminchiyunnavu
Nee polikalone nivasinchamannavu
Neevu nannu ennukuntivi 
Nee korakai Nee krupalo  
Hallelluya Yessayya (2)

You have created Your image in me
You asked me to live in Your likeness
You have chosen me
For Your sake by your grace 
Hallelujah Jesus 

Naa manavulu mundhe Nee manasulo neravere
Naa manugada mundhe Nee grandhamulonunde
Yemi adbhutha prema sankalpam 
Nenemi chellinthunu   
Halleluyah Yessaya

Every thought of mine is known to You
Everything I need is there in the Word
What a wonderful plan You have for me 
How can I repay 
Hallelujah Jesus 

Naa Shramalu Sahinchi, Naa Ashrayamainavu
Naa Vyadhalu Bharinchi nannadukunnavu
Nannu Neelo Cherchukunavu –
Nanu Daachiyunavvu 
Halleluyah Yessaya

You bore my burden and became my shelter
You carried my worries and embraced me
You have taken me in and hidden me in You
Hallelujah Jesus

title: Yese naa parihari
lyrics:
Yese naa parihari, 
Priya Yese naa parihari
Naa jeevitha kaalamella  
Priya Prabhuve naa parihari -2

Jesus is my redeemer,
Beloved Jesus is my redeemer
All through my life,
Jesus is my redeemer

Enni kashtalu kaligananu 
Nannu krunginche badhalenno -2
Enni nashtalu shobillina 
Priya Prabhuvey naa parihari -2

In all my difficulties,
In distressing ordeals
In all losses that I incur,
Beloved Lord is my redeemer

Nannu Sathanu vembadinchina 
Nannu shatruvu edurinchina -2
Palu nindalu nanu chuttina
Priya Prabhuvey naa parihari -2

Even if Satan follows me,
Even if enemy challenges me
Even if many accusations surround me,
Beloved Lord is my redeemer

Maani maanyalu lekunna
Mano vedanalu vedinchina -2
Narullelaru nanu vidachina 
Priya Prabhuvey naa parihari -2

Even if I do not have jewels and pearls,
Even if heart aches agonize me
Even if all men desert me,
Beloved Lord is my redeemer

Bahu vyadulu nanu sokina
Naku shanti karuvaina -2
Nannu shodakudu shodinchina
Priya Prabhuvey naa parihari -2

Even if many diseases infect me,
Even if I lose my peace
Even if the tempter tempts/tests me,
Beloved Lord is my redeemer

Devaa Neeve naa aadhaaramu 
Nee premaku saate evvaru -2
Naa jeevitha kaalamantha
Ninnu paadi stuthinchedhanu	 -2

Lord You are my basis,
Nothing can be compared to Your love
All through my life,
I will sing of Your praises

title: Naa priyamaina Yesu prabhu
lyrics:
Naa priya maina Yesu Prabhu, veladi sthrothramulu
Nee vichina rakshana kai, Deva sthothramu sthothramulu (2)

My beloved Lord Jesus, many praises to You
Many many praises for You’re the salvation You gave me

Aapadha dinamulalo, naa prabhuni talachithini -2
Deva nee daya thodane, naatha ashrayamu pondithini -2

In my day of trouble, I remembered (cried out to) my Lord
Lord, in your mercy You gave me shelter

Oka kshana samaymulo, nasinchu naa jeveetham -2
Naa hrudiyam marchitivi, Deva krupa thone jeevinchutakayi -2

My life could vanish in a moment
You changed my heart to live in Your grace

Ee dinamu ne paduta, Nee valane Yesu Prabhu -2
Elappudu ne padedan Deva, na yandu vasiyinchumu -2

Its only because of You that I sing today
I will sing forever, Lord, dwell in me

title: Hallelujah Paadeda
lyrics:
Hallelujah paadedaa, Prabhu Ninnu koniyaadedan (2)
Anni velalayandunaa, Ninnu poojinchi keerthinthunu (2)
Prabhuvaa Ninnu ne koniyaadedan 

I will sing hallelujah, I will praise You
I will praise and worship You at all times
Lord, I will praise You

Vaagdhaanamulan ichchi neraverchuvaadavu Neeve (2)
Nammakamaina Deva nannu Kaapaaduvadavu Neeve (2)
Prabhuvaa Ninnu ne koniyaadedan

You are the One Who gives promises and fulfills them
O faithful God, You are the One Who protects me
Lord I will praise You

Endaru Ninu choochiro, vaariki velugu kalgen (2)
Prabhuva Nee velugondithin, Naa jeevampu jyothivi Neeve (2)
Prabhuvaa Ninnu ne koniyaadedan

All those who looked/gazed at You received light
Lord, I too got enlightened, You are the light of my life
Lord I will praise You

Rakshakudaina Yesu Maanava Janmanethi
Janminche nee korakai
Nee papamu kshaminchutakai
Yesu nee korakai vechivunden

Saviour Jesus took the form of man
Jesus is waiting for you
He was born for you to forgive your sins

Kashtamulannintini, priyamuga bhariyinthunu (2)
Nee korake jeevinthunu, naa jeevampu daathavu Neeve (2)
Prabhuvaa Ninnu ne koniyaadedan

I will rejoice in all my suffering
I will live for You, You are the One Who gives me life
Lord I will praise You

title: Naa prana priyuda
lyrics:
Naa praana priyuda Yesu Raja,  
Arpinthunu naa hrudayarpana
Virigi-naligina aatmatonu,
Hrudaya-poorvaka aaradhanato-sathyamuga
Naa praana priyuda Yesu Raja,
Arpinthunu naa hrudayarpana

My beloved King Jesus,
I offer You my heart
With a broken-contrite heart 
I worship from my heart in spirit and truth 
My beloved King Jesus, 
I offer You my heart

Adbutha karuda aalochana,
Aascharya samadhana Prabhuva
Balavanthuda bahu-priyuda 
Ma-noharuda mahima Raja, keerthincheda

Wonderful Counsellor, 
Amazing Prince of Peace
Mighty God, beloved who fills my heart, 
King of Glory, I praise You

Vi-mocha-na gaa-namulatho
Soundarya prema sthuthulatho
Na-maskarinchi aaradhintun, 
Harshintunu ne padedanu, na Prabhuva

With songs of Your redemption and 
Praises of Your amazing love
I will bow down and worship and 
Rejoice and sing for You my Lord

Gharbamuna puttina biddanu,
Karunimpa-ka talli marachuna,
Marichina gani nevennadu 
Maruvavu viduvavu yedabayavu, karuna Raja

A mother, who gave birth to her child, from her womb, 
Can she forget her child?
Even if she forgot, You would never 
Leave or forsake me, O Lord of mercy

title: Ooghinchaleni
lyrics:
Oohinchaleni melulatho nimpina
Naa Yesayyaa Neeku naa vandanam (2)
Varninchagalanaa Nee kaaryamul
Vivarinchagalanaa Nee melulan (2)

My Jesus, I worship You for filling me 
With Your unfathomable goodness.
I may not be able to describe Your works
Nor can I explain Your goodness

Melutho naa hrudayam thrupthiparachinaavu
Rakshana paathragurchi Ninu sthuthiyinthunu (2)
Israyelu Devudaa naa rakshakaa
Sthuthiyinthunu Nee naamamunu (2)

You have satisfied my heart with Your goodness
I praise You about the cup of salvation.
God of Israel is my Redeemer
And I’ll worship Your Name

Naa deenasthithini Neevu maarchinaavu
Naa jeevithaaniki viluvanichinaavu (2)
Nee krupatho nannu aavarinchinaavu
Nee sannidhi naaku thodunichchinaavu (2)

You have changed my lowly state
And have given value to my life
You have encompassed me with Your grace
And accompanied Your presence with me

title: Ruchi chuchi
lyrics:
Ruchi chuchi yerigithi nee, Yehovah uthamudaniyu -2
Rakshaka nashraiinchi ne dhanyudanythini -2

I have tasted and learned, that Jehovah is good
Am blessed by accepting the Savior

Goppa Devuda vu Neeve, stuthulaaku paathruda Neeve -2
Thaappaka araadhinthun daayaludavu Neeve -2

You are the great God and You are worthy of all praises
I must worship You for You are very kind

Mahona thudavagu Deva, prabhavamugalavada -2
Manasaara pogadedhanu Nee ascharya kaaryamulan -2

God You are Most High and You are majestic
I praise Your wonderful works with all of my heart

Praardhinthunu edathegaka, Prabhu sannidhilo cheri -2
Sampoornamuga pondhedhanu aduguvaatannitini -2

I will sing for Him in His presence,
For He fulfills all my desires

title: Neeve naa pranamu
lyrics:
Neeve na pranamu, Neeve na sarvamu
Neeve na jeevamu, Yesaiah! (2)
Maruvalenu Needu prema
Viduvalenaya Nee sneham (2)

You are my life, You are my everything
You are my life, Jesus
I cannot forget Your love
And I cannot leave Your friendship.

Margam Neeve satyam jeevam Neeve
Jeevinchutaku aadhaaram Neeve (2)
Brathukantha Nee korakai jeevintunu
Ninu nenu aaraadhitun (2)

You are the path, the truth and the life
You are the source to live
All my life I will live for You alone and
I worship You 

Thodu Neeve, na needa Neeve
Nithyam naathodu unde chelimi Neeve (2)
Apayamu raakunda kaapaduvaadavu
Ninu nenu aaraadhintun (2)

You are my help, my shade and
You are my ever-present friend
You are the one who protects from danger and
I worship You

title: Oohalakandhanidhi
lyrics:
Oohalakandhanidhi Nee thyagam varnimpajaalanidhi
Oosulakandhanidhi Nee yaagam vivarimpajaalanidhi
Nee korake aa thyagam mana korake bali yaagam
Entha premayya Yesu vintha premayya -2

Your sacrifice is unfathomable and indescribable
Your sacrifice is beyond what I can visualize or describe
This sacrifice is for you and for us
Jesus, Your love is very vast and strange

Evaruu chupani Nee prema, naakai chupina naa Deva
Evaruu cheyani aa tyagam, naakai chesina naa Prabhuva
Emani varninthunu, emani vivarinthunu
Nee goppa thyaganni Yesu aa goppa yaaganni (2)

My God, You have shown the love that no one could show
My Lord, no one could make the sacrifice that You did for me
Jesus, what must I describe about 
Your great sacrifice?

Naalo manchi ledhaniyu thelisee thanayuniga pilachi
Enchaleni manchini nalo penchalani yenchi
Yaagamai bali yaagamai thyagamai praana thyagamai
Naakai maraninchinaa Yesu nannu brathikinchinaa (2)

You called me Your child knowing that there is no good in me
You chose me to fill me with immeasurable goodness
You became the sacrifice by sacrificing Your life
You died for me my Jesus and made me alive

title: Najareyuda naa Yesayya
lyrics:
Najareyuda, naa Yesayyaa,
Yenni yugaalakainaa, aaradhya Dhaivam Neevenani,
Galametthi nee keerthi ne chaatedha

My Jesus, the Nazarene
I will open my mouth and will proclaim Your Glory that You alone are God worthy of worship for all ages

Aakasha gaganaalanu, Nee jena tho kolichithivi -2
Soonyamulo ee bhoomini vrelaada, dheesina naa Yesayyaa -2
Neeke vandhanam -4

You measured the Heavens with the span of Your hand
My Jesus, You suspended this Earth in the space
Praises to You alone

Aghadha samudhralakuu Neeve, yellalu vesithivi -2
Jalamulalo badi ne vellinaa, nannemi cheyavu naa Yesayaa -2
Neeke vandhanam -4

You have set the limits to the deepest seas
My Jesus, even if I go along with the waters nothing will happen to me
Praises to You alone

Seeyonu sikhara-agramuu Nee, simhasana-maayenaa -2
Seeyonulo ninnu choodaalani aasha, tho unnanu naa Yesayya -2
Neeke vandhanam -4

The summit of mount Zion has become Your throne
My Jesus, I live with the desire to see You in Zion
Praises to You alone

title: Kreesthe sarvaadhikaari
lyrics:
Kreesthe Sarvaadhikaari 
Kreesthe Mokshaadhikaari
Kreesthe Mahopakaari 
Kreesthe Aa Silvadhaari
Kreesthe Sarvaadhikaari......          

Christ is Sovereign over all
Christ is the Redeemer
Christ is the great helper 
Christ is the one who bore the cross

Mukthi Vidhaatha Netha 
Shakthi Nosamgu Dhaatha
Bhakthi Vilaapa Shrotha 
Paramambu Veede Gaana            
Kreesthe Sarvaadhikaari......          

Provider of salvation 
Giver of Strength
Hearer of the cries of his saints,
The one who left the heavens

Shaashwatha Lokavaasi 
Sathyaamruthampu Raashi
Shaapa Bhaarambu Mosi 
Shramala Sahinche Gaana          
Kreesthe Sarvaadhikaari......          

The eternal one
Full of truth
He bore the burden of our curse 
Endured the suffering

Paramandhu Divijulaina 
Dharayandhu Manujulaina
Prathi Naaluka Mokaalu
Prabhune Bhajinchu Gaana     
Kreesthe Sarvaadhikaari......          

The Heavenly host 
The people on earth
Every tongue and knee 
Worship only the Lord

title: O Yesu Nee prema
lyrics:
O Yesu Nee Prema Entho Mahaaneeyamu...
Aakaasha Thaara Parvatha Samudhra-mula Kanna Goppadhi (2)  
O Yesu Nee Prema..

O Jesus, your love is very great
So greater than the heavens, stars, mountains, and oceans

Agamya Aanandhame Hrudayamu Nindenu
Prabhuni Kaaryamulu Gambheeramainavi
Prathi Udhaya Saayanthramulu 
Sthuthiki Yogyamulu (2)O Yesu Nee Prema…

My heart is filled with unending joy
The works of the Lord are enormous
Every morning and Evening
He is worthy to praised

Sankata samayamulo saagalekunnaanu
Dayachoopu naa meedhaa ani nenu morra pettagaa
Vintinantivi naa moraku mundhe 
Thodu nundhunantivi (2)              
O Yesu Nee Prema..

In the times of distress though unable to press forward
When I cried to you to show mercy on me
You heard me even before my cry
You said you will be with me

Kodhuvulenni Yunnaa- Bhayapadanu Ne Nepudu
Pachika Bayalulo Parunda Jeyunu
Bhojana Jalamulatho Thrupthiparachuchu 
Naatho Nundu yesu (2) 
O Yesu Nee Prema..

I will no longer fear even if I lack anything
He makes me lie down in green pastures
He is satisfying me (soul) with food and water
Jesus be with me

Devuni Gruhamulo Sadhaa Sthuthinchedhanu
Sampoorna Hrudayamutho Sadhaa Bhajinchedhanu
Sthuthi Prashamsa-laku Yogyudesu
Halleluyaa Amen (2)  
O Yesu Nee Prema..

I will praise God always in his sanctuary
I will worship him always with my whole heart
Jesus is worthy of praises and adoration

title: Nadipinchu Naa Naavaa
lyrics:
Nadipinchu Naa Naavaa – Nadi Sandhramuna Devaa
Nava Jeevana Maargamuna – Naa Janma Thariyimpa    
Nadipinchu Naa Naavaa...

Captain my boat in midst of the sea
In the path of new life 
Let my life find satisfaction

Naa Jeevitha Theeramuna – Naa Apajaya Bhaaramuna
Naligina Naa Hrudhayamunu – Nadipinchumu Lothunaku
Naa aathma Virabooya – Naa Deeksha Phaliyimpa
Naa Naavalo Kaalidumu – Naa Seva Chekonumu   
Nadipinchu Naa Naava..

My life is overwhelmed with the burden of my failures
Lead my contrite heart in to deep
Let my spirit flourish - let my devotion bear fruit  
Step into my life (boat) and accept my service

Raathranthayu Shramapadinaa – Raaledu Prabhu Jayamu
Rahadaarulu Vedakinanoo – Raadaayenu Prathiphalamu
Rakshinchu Nee Siluva – Ramaneeya Lothulalo
Rathanaalanu Vedakutalo – Raajillu Naa Padava            
Nadipinchu Naa Naava..

I laboured all night- 
But did not triumph 
I was not rewarded though I searched all roads
Save me by your cross and lead my boat into the deep to find the precious stones

Aathmarpana Cheyakaye – Aashinchiti Nee Chelimi
Ahamunu Preminchuchune – Arasithi Prabhu Neekalimi
Aasha Nirashaye – Aavedha Nedhuraye
Aadhyathmika Lemigani – Allade Naa valalu                    
Nadipinchu Naa Naava..

Without offering my life to you I desired your fellowship
By loving self, I sought your presence
Despaired of all my hopes, I encountered agony
Deprived of all spiritual life, my boat (waves) rippled

Prabhu Maargamu Vidichithini – Prardhinchuta Maanithini
Parbhu Vaakyamu Vadhalithini – Paramardhamu Marichithini
Prapancha Natanalalo – Praveenyamunu Pondhi
Phala heenudanai ipudu – Paatinthu Nee Maata     
Nadipinchu Naa Naava..

I left the Lord’s way – I stopped praying
I neglected the Lord’s word
I deserted the heavenly purpose
I revelled in the worldly ways
And became unfruitful. I will follow your word hereafter

Lothaina Jalamulalo – Lothuna Vinabadu Swaramaa
Lobadutanu Nerpinchi – Lopambulu Savarinchi
Lonunna Eevulalo – Lothaina Naa Brathuku
Lopinchani Arpanagaa – Lokesha Cheyumayaa            
Nadipinchu Naa Naava..

Your voice is heard even in the deep waters 
Teach me to submit and reform my errors
Even my deepest desires and all my life be accepted as a living sacrifice and let me overcome the world   

Prabhu Yesuni Sishyudanai – Prabhu Premalo Paadhukoni
Prakatinthunu Lokamulo – Parishuddhuni Prema Kadha
Paramaathma Prokshanatho – Paripoorna Samarpanatho
Praanambunu Prabhu Koraku – Paanaarpanamu jethu   
Nadipinchu Naa Naavaa...

Let me be a disciple of the Lord Jesus - let me be rooted in the love of the Lord
Let me proclaim the love of the Holy one in this world
With the help of the Holy Spirt
And with full dedication.
I offer my life to the Lord as a living sacrifice

title: Paadedha deva nee krupalan
lyrics:
Paadedha deva – nee krupalan 
Nuthana geethamulan 
Sthothramu chellinthun
Sthuthi Sthothramu chellinthun  

Lord, I will sing of your grace
With new songs
And I sing praises to you

Bhoomi punaadhulu veyakamundhe yesulo jhuchithivi (2)
Prema punaadhulu vesithivi dheenuni brochithivi 
Ee dheenuni brochithivi 

You saw me in Jesus even before you laid the foundations the earth
You laid the foundations of love and saved a lowly person like me

Paapamu shaapamu narakapu vedhana mari tholaginchithivi  (2)
Aparaadhamulache chachina nannu dhara brathikinchithivi 
Nannu brathikinchithivi 

You abolished the agony of sin, curse and hell
I was dead in sins – You saved me

Devuni raajyapu vaarasudanuga kreesthulo chesithivi (2)
Cheekati raajyapu shakthula nundi nannu vidipinchithivi
Chera vidipinchithivi  

In Christ you made me an heir of God’s kingdom
You delivered me from the powers of the kingdom of darkness
You set me free from the captivity

Mudhrinchithivi shuddhathmatho nanu bhadhramu chesithivi  (2)
Sathya swaroopi nithya nivaasi sotthuga chesithivi 
Nee sotthuga chesithivi

You sealed me with the Holy Spirit and you preserved me
You made me a possession of the Eternal and the true one

title: Sthuthiyu mahima ghanatha neeke
lyrics:
Sthuthiyu mahima ghanatha neeke, 
Yuga yugamula varaku
Entho nammadhagina deva (2)

1. Maa Devudavai maakicchithivi 
Entho goppa shubha dhinamu (2)
Memandaramu uthsaahinchi Santhoshinchedhamu (2)
Koniyaadedhamu maruvabadani 
Melula jesenani (2)

2. Nee okkadave goppa Devudavu Ghanakaaryamulu cheyudhuvu (2)
Needhu krupaye nirantharamu Nilichiyundunugaa (2)
Ninnu memu aanandhamutho aaradhinchedhamu (2)

3. Neeve maaku parama-Prabhudavai
Nee chitthamu neraverchithivi (2)
Jeevamunicchi nadipinchinthivi 
Nee Aathmaa dhwaara (2)
Nadipinchedhavu samabhoomigala Pradhesamulo nannu (2)

4. Bhariyinchithivi sramalu nindhalu Orchithivanni maakoraku (2)
Maranamu gelchi odinchithivi 
Saathanu bhalamun (2)
Paramu nundi maakai vacche 
Prabhu-Yesu jayamu (2)

title: Bhasillenu siluvalo paapa kshama
lyrics:
Bhasillenu siluvalo paapa Kshama
Yesu Prabhu nee divya Kshama -Bhasillenu

1. Kaluvarilo na paapamu ponchi
Siluvaku Ninnu yaahuthi chese
Kalushaharaa karuninchithivi (2)

2. Paapamu chesi gadinchithi maranam
Shaapamega nenaarjinchinadhi
Kaaparivai nanu brochithivi (2)

3. Endulako naapai ee prema
Andhadhayaa swami naa madhiki
Andulake bhayamondhithini (2)

4. Nammina vaarini kaadhana-vaniyu
Nemmadhi nosagedi naa Prabhudavani
Nammithi nee paadhambhulanu (2)

title: Sthuthyinchedha Nee Naamam
lyrics:
Sthuthiyinchedha Nee Naamam - Deva Anudhinam (2)

1.Dhayatho Kaapadinaavu 
Krupane Chupinchinaavu (2)
Ninu ne Maruvanesu - Ninu ne Viduvanesu

2. Paapinai Yundaga Nenu 
Rakshinchi Dhari Cherchinaavu (2)
Ninu ne Maruvanesu - Ninu ne Viduvanesu

3. Siluve Naaku Sharanam 
Yese Naaku Maargam (2)
Ninu ne Maruvanesu - Ninu ne Viduvanesu

title: Yehova nee krupathisayamunu
lyrics:
Yehova Nee krupathisayamunu 
Nithyamu keerthinthun (2)

1. Thara-tharamulaku neevey swasyatha Theliyaa parachedhanu(2)
Kaluvari siluvaa rakthamutho
Nibhandhana sthiraparachi
Paapamu kshamiyinchi

2. Needhoo rakada varaku nannu Nindharahithuniga(2)
Nammakamai-yunnaa naa Prabhuva, Nannu kaachedhavu(2)

3. Manchi poratamu poraadi 
Jayamunu pondhedhanu(2)
Mahima makutamu 
Nitchedu Prabhunaku 
Halleluyah padedhan(2)

title: Devude naakaashrayambu
lyrics:
Devude Naakaasharayambu 
Devude Naakaashrayambu
Divyamaina Durgamu 
Mahaa Vinodu Daapadala
Sahaayudai Nan Brochunu 
Abhaya Mabhaya Mabhaya Meppudu
Ananda Maananda Maananda Mouga    ||Devude||

1.Parvathamulu Kadilina Nee-
Yurvi Maaru Padinanu 
Sarvamun Ghoshinchuchu Nee
Sandra Mupponginanu ||Abhaya||

2.Devudepdu Thodugaaga-
Deshamu Vardhillunu 
Aa Thaavu Nandu Prajalu Migula Dhanyulai Vasinthuru ||Abhaya||

3.Raajyamul Kampinchina Bhoo-
Raashtramul Ghoshinchina 
Poojyundou Yehovaa Vairi Booni Samharinchunu ||Abhaya||

title: Devuni Stuthiyinchudi
lyrics:
Devuni Sthuthiyinchudi
Ellappudu Devuni Sthuthiyinchudi (Aa aa aa aa) ||Devuni||

1.Aayana Parishudhdha Aalayamandu (2)
Aayana Sannidhilo Aa Aa (2) ||Ellapudu||

2.Aayana Balamunu Prasidhdhi Cheyu (2)
Aakashavishaalamandu Aa Aa (2) ||Ellappudu||

3.Aayana Paraakrama Kaaryamul Batti (2)
Aayana Prabhavamunu Aa Aa (2) ||Ellappudu||

4.Booradhvanitho Aayanan Sthuthinchudi (2)
Svaramandalamulatho Aa Aa (2) ||Ellappudu||

5.Sanna Thanthula Sithaarathonu (2)
Chakkani Svaramulatho Aa Aa (2) ||Ellappudu||

6.Thamburathonu Naatyamuthonu (2)
Thanthi Vaadyamulathonu Aa Aa (2) ||Ellappudu||

7.Pillanagrovula Challaganoodi (2)
Ellaprajalu Jeri Aa Aa (2) ||Ellappudu||

8.Mroguthaalamulatho Aayanan Sthuthinchudi (2)
Gambheera Thaalamutho Aa Aa (2) ||Ellappudu||

9.Sakala Praanulu Yehovan Sthuthinchudi (2)
Hallelooyaa Aamen Aa Aa (2) ||Ellappudu||

title: Shaashwathamainadi
lyrics:
Shaashwathamainadi Neevu Naa Yeda Choopina Krupa 
Anukshanam Nanu Kanupaapa Vale (2)
Kaachina Krupa ||Shaashwatha||

1.Neeku Bahu Dooramaina Nannu 
Chera Deesina Naa Thandrivi (2)
Nithya Sukha Shaanthiye Naaku
Needu Kougililo (2)  ||Shaashwatha||

2.Thalli Thana Biddalanu Marachinaa
Nenu Maruvalenantive (2)
Needu Mukha Kaanthiye Nannu Aadarinchenule (2) ||Shaashwatha||

3.Parvathamulu Tholaginanu 
Mettalu Thattharillina (2)
Naa Krupa Ninu Veedadani Abhayamichchithive (2)  ||Shaashwatha||

title: Yehova ne namamu song:
lyrics:
Yehovaa Nee Naamamu Entho Balamainadi 
Aa.. Aa.. Aa.. Entho Balamainadi 
Yesayya Nee Naamamu Entho Ghanamainadi 
Aa.. Aa.. Aa.. Entho Ghanamainadi   ||Yehovaa||

1.Moshe Praardhinchagaa
Mannaanu Kuripinchithivi (2) 
Yehoshuva Praardhinchagaa 
Suryuni aapithivi (2)
Yehovaa Nee Naamamu

2.Nee Prajala Pakshamugaa 
Yudhdhamulu Chesina Devaa (2)
Agnilo Padavesinaa 
Bhayamemi Lekundiri (2)
Yehovaa Nee Naamamu

3.Simhaala Bonukainaa 
Santoshamugaa Velliri (2) 
Praardhinchina Ventane 
Rakshinche Nee Hasthamu (2)
Yehovaa Nee Naamamu

4.Cherasaalalo Vesinaa 
Sankellu Bigiyinchinaa (2) 
Sanghamu Praardhinchagaa 
Sankellu Vidipoyenu (2)  ||Yehovaa||

title: Aanandham Neelone
lyrics:
Aanandam neelone – Aadhaaram neevega
Aasrayam neelone – Naa Yesayya, stotraarhuda /2/
Arhathe leni nannu – preminchinaavu
Jeevintu ilalo neekosame saakshaardhamai

1. Padhepadhe ninne cheraga.. Pratikshanam neeve dhyaasaga.. /2/
kalavaraala kotalo – Kanneeti baatalo /2/
Kaapade kavachamuga – Nannu aadarinchina!
Divyaksehetrama – Sthothra geethama 

2. Nirantharam neeve velugani – Nityamaina swaasthyam neevani /2/
Nee sannidhi veedaka – Sannutinchi paadana /2/
Neekorake dwhajametti ninnu prakatinchana
Satya vaakyame – Jeeva vaakyame 

3. Sarva satyamenaa maargamai – Sangha kshemamena praanamai /2/
Lokamahima choodaka – Nee jaadalu veedaka /2/
Neethone nilavaali – nitya seeyonulo
Needarshanam Naa aashayam

title: Ayane na sangeetamu
lyrics:
Aayane Naa Sangeetamu - Balamaina Kotayunu
Jeevaadhi Patiyu Aayane Jeevita Kaalamella Sthuthiyinchedanu
Jeevita Kaalamella Sthuthinchedanu

1. Stutula Madhyalo nivaasamchesi – Doothalella pogadu Devudaayane (2)
Veduchundu Bhaktula moralu Vini  (2)
Dikkuleni Pillalaku Devudaayane (2)  

2. Iddaru Mugguru Naa Naamamuna - ekeebhavinchina Vaari Madhyalona (2)
Unde dhananina Mana Devuni (2)
Karamulu Tatti Nityam Sthuthinchedamu (2)

3. Srushtikartha Kreestu yesu Naamamuna - Jeevita Kaalamella Keertinchedamu (2)
Raakadalo Prabhunito Nityamundumu (2) 
Mrokkedamu Keerthinthumu  Pogadedhamu (2)

title: Yehova na kapari
lyrics:
Yehova naa kaapari 
Naaku lemi kalugadu
Pacchikagala chotlalo aayana nannu 
Parundajeyu chunnaadu (2)

1. Shaantikaramaina jalamulayodda 
Nannu nadipinchuchunnaadu (2)
Naa praana munaku aayana Sedadeerchuchunnaadu 
Thana naamamunubatti Neetimargamulalo- Nannu nadipinchuchunnaadu (2)

2. Gaadhaandhakaarapu loyalo
Nenu sancharinchinanu (2) 
Ae apaayamunakku bhayapadanu
Neevu naaku todayunduvu 
Nee duddukarraayu Needandamunu - Nannu aadarinchunu (2)     

3. Naa shatruvula yeduta neevu naaku 
Bhojanamu siddhaparachuduvu
Nunetoo naa thala antiyunnaavu
Naa ginne nindiporluchunnaadi
Nenu brathuku dinamulaniyu
Krupaakshemamule naa venta vachunu 
Chirakaalamu Yehovah mandiramulo- Nenu nivaasamu cheysedhanu (2)

title: Aascharyamaina Prema
lyrics:
Aascharyamaina Prema, kalvariloni Prema
Maranamu Kante Balamaina Premadi
Nannu Jayinche Nee Prema (2) 

1. Paramunu Veedina Prema Dharalo - 
Paapini Vedakina Prema (2) 
Nannu Karuninchi Aadarinchi - 
Sedadeerchi Nithya Jeevamichhe (2)     

2. Paavana Yesuni Prema Siluvalo - 
Paapini Mosina Prema (2) 
Naakai Maraninchi Jeevamichhi -  
Jayamichhi Thana Mahimanichhe (2)            

3. Shramalu Sahinchina Prema Naakai - 
Shaapamu Norchina Prema (2) 
Vidanaadani Premadhi - 
Ennadu Edabaayadhu (2)                        

4. Naa Sthithi choochina Prema Naapai - 
Jaalini Choopina Prema (2) 
Naakai Parugethi Kougilinchi -  
Muddhaadi Kanneetini-Thudiche (2)

title: Anaadhi devudu aashrayamu
lyrics:
Anaadhi devudu aashrayamu
Thana baahuvulu nee kaadhaarame

Nithyamaina sathya devudu 
Sarvakaalamu mana devudu 
Maranamu varaku mammu nadipinchunu

1. Karunathone aakarshinche shuddha divya prema
Ee aranyamulo aasha choopineeku 
Brathimaaluchu ninnu pilichen 

2. Ee bhuvin neevu gadupu yaatra prabhuvu dayavalane
Kaaradaviyainan Prabhu rommunane 
Dorukunu nemmadhi neeku

3. Endina jeevithamu chigurinchinade daivakrupa valane
Shashwataanandamu shiramupai velayun 
Dukkamu nittoorpulu-povun 

4. Santasamutho thirigi rammu daiva balamuche
Siyonu kondakaayana ninnu cherchunu
Shaashwataananda mondedavu

title: Gathakaalamantha Nee needalona
lyrics:
Gathakaalamantha Nee needalona
Dachavu Deva Vandhanam
Krupa choopinavu kaapadinaavu
Ela theercha galanu ni runam

Paadana nee Keerthana - Pogadana venollana (2) 
Vandhanam Yesayya - Ghanudavu neevayya (2)

1. Enneno avamaanal edurainanu
Nee prema nannu vidachi poledayya
Ikkatlatho nenu krunginanu
Ni cheyi nanu thaaki lepenaya
Nijamaina nee prema nishkalankamu
Neevichu hasthamu nindu dhairyamu (2)
Vandhanam Yesayya, ghanudavu neevayya (2) 

2. Maatale mulluga maarina Vela
Nee-maata nannu palakarinchenaya
Nindhalatho nenu nindina Vela
Nee-dakshina hasthamu-nannu thakenaya
Nee maata chakkati jeevapu voota
Maruvanennadu ninnu sthuthiyinchuta (2)
Vandhanam Yesayya, ghanudavu nivayya (2)

title: Neetho Samamevaru
lyrics:
Neetho Samamevaru, Neelaa Preminchedevaru
Neelaa Kshamiyinchedevaru Yesayyaa
Neelaa Paapikai Praanam Pettina Vaarevaru (2)

1. Loka Bangaaramu, Dhana Dhaanyaadulu
Oka Pogesinaa, Neetho Sarithoogunaa
Jeeva Nadulanniyu, Sarva Sandramulu
Okatai Egasina, Ninnu Thaakagalavaa
Loka Soukhyaalannee Oka Chota Kummarinchina
Neevegaa Chaalina Devudavu

2. Palu Vedaalalo, Matha Granthaalalo
Paapame Sokani, Parishuddhudedi
Paapa Parihaaraartham, Siluva Maranamondi
Thirigi Lechinatti, Daiva Narudevvaru
Neelaa Parishuddha Devudeva-runnaarayyaa
Neevegaa Manchi Devudavu

3. Nenu Vedakakunnaa, Naaku Dorikithivi
Nenu Preminchakunnaa, Nannu Preminchithivi
Palu Gaayaalu Chesi, Tharachu Repithini
Nannentho Sahinchi, Kshamiyinchithivi
Neelaa Jaaligala Premagala Devudedi
Neevegaa Vimochakudavu

title: Nee Vaakyame Nannu Brathikinchenu
lyrics:
Nee Vaakyame Nannu Brathikinchenu
Baadhalalo Nemmadinichhenu (2)
Krupaa Shakthi Dayaa Sathya Sampoornudaa
Vaakyamai Unna Yesu Vandanamayyaa (2)

1. Jigatagala Oobhinundi Levanethhenu
Samathalamagu Bhoomipai Nannu Nilipenu (2)
Naa Paadamulaku Dheepamaayenu (2)
Sathyamaina Maargamulo Nadupuchundenu (2)        

2. Shathruvulanu Edurkone Sarvaanga Kavachamai
Yudhhamunaku Sidhha Manasu-nichhuchunnadhi (2)
Apavaadi Veyuchunna Agni Baanamulanu (2)
Khadgamu Vale Addukoni Aarpi Veyuchunnadhi (2)      

3. Paalavantidhi Junte Thene Vantidhi
Naa Jihhvaku Mahaa Madhuramainadhi (2)
Melimi Bangaaru Kanna Minna Ainadhi (2)
Rathna Raasulakannaa Koradhaginadhi (2)

title: Idhi ascharyame
lyrics:
Kalam Sampoornamainapudu - Yesayya Bhuvikocchenu
Thaane Manalanu Preminchi Rakshakudai Janminchenu
Rajadhi Rajainanu - Ilalo Daasuniga Jeevinchenu
Sathyamunu Sthaapinchutaku Daiva Suthuniga udayinchenu

When the time was fulfilled - Jesus came to the earth
He loved us and was born as the Savior
Though He is the King of Kings - He lived as a servant on this earth
To establish the truth - He appeared as the Son of God

IDI ascharyame - IDI Adbhuthame - Aha Anandame -  Happy Happy Christmas
IDI asharyame - IDI Adbhuthame - Aha Anandame -  Merry Merry Christmas

This is a wonder - This is amazing - Oh, what joy - Happy, Happy Christmas
This is a wonder - This is amazing - Oh, what joy – Merry, Merry Christmas

Gnaanulu Saagilapadiri - Mrokkiri Prabhuvula Prabhuvunu
Atuvale Viswasinchuchu - Poojinchedham Prabhu Yesunu
Sarvonnathamaina Sthalamulalona -  Deva Devunike Mahima
Thana kishtulaina Prajalandariki -  Bhoomi Meeda Samadhaanamu 

The wise men bowed down - Worshipped the Lord of Lords
Likewise, let us believe and worship the Lord Jesus
Glory to God in the highest places
May the peace be on the people of earth in whom He delights

Gollalu Devuni Matanu - Grahiyinchiri Dhootha Cheppaga
Vidheyathe Manaku Mukhyamu -  Grahiyinchumu Devuni Chitthamu
Vakyamaina Devudu Shareeradhariga -  Mana Madhyalo Nivasinchenu 
Nammi Viswasinchumu Kalugu Nithya Jeevamu -  Yesu Kreesthe Loka rakshakudu

The shepherds understood God’s word when the angel spoke
Obedience is important for us – We ought to Understand God’s will
He is the Word who became flesh - and dwelt among us
You will receive eternal life if you believe and trust, that Jesus Christ is the Savior of the world

title: CHRISTMAS SUBHAVELALO
lyrics:
Christmas subhavelalo – 
mana andhari hrudhayaalalo
Aanandhamaanandhame – 
manasanthaa santhoshame (2)

Sthuthiyinchi aaraadhiddham
Aa prabhuni ghanaparachi keerthinchudhaam
Rakshakudu puttaadani – 
manaku rakshana thechaadani (2)

1.Dhaaveedhu puramandhu rakshakudu
Mana korakai janminchadu
Dhevaadhi devuni kumaarudu 
rikthunigaa bhuvikochaadu (2)
Aa prabhuve narudaayenu – 
lokamunu preminchenu
Mana paapamu tholaginchenu – 
parishuddhulugaa chesenu (2)

2. Sarvonnathamaina sthalamulalo – 
dhevunike mahima
Aanandhame aascharyame – 
santhosham samaadhaaname (2)
Dhoothaale sthothrinchiri – 
kaaparulu chaatinchiri
Prabhu yesu puttaadani – 
manaku thodai untaadani (2)
 
3. Vinthaina thaara velasindhani – 
gnaanulu kanugontiri
Aa thaara vembadi vaarochiri – 
prabhuyesuni dharsinchiri (2)
Raajulake raajani – 
prabhuvulake prabhuvani
Kaanukalu arpinchiri – 
vinamrathatho poojinchiri (2)

title: Sthothram stuthi sthothram
lyrics:
Sthothram stuthi sthothram 
Mahima ghanatha neeke 
Arpinthunu yesayya (2) 
Naa kosam maraninchi thirigi lechina 
Neeke naa sthuthi sthothramu (2) 

1. Baadha kalugu samayamulo  
Naaku thodai nilachi 
Kasta nastaalalo naaku needai nilachi (2) 
Nanu dhairyaparachithivi 
Naa venta nilachithivi (2) 
Naa kosam maraninchi thirigi lechina 
Neeke naa sthuthi sthothramu (2)
 
2. Ne chesina paapamukai  
Siksha neevu pondhithivi 
Ne chesina dhoshamukai  
Siluvalo maraninchithivi (2) 
Mruthyunjayudai nilachi  
Maranaanne gelichithivi (2) 
Naa kosam maraninchi thirigi lechina 
Neeke naa sthuthi sthothramu (2)

title: Neelone Anandham
lyrics:
Neelone Anandham Naa deva 
Neelone naaku jeevam (2) 
Ninaanedu nirantharam maarani deva (2) 
Ee lokhamantha nenu vedakina  
Ledaya ekkada Anandham  
Ne sannidhilo okakshanam gadipina  
Na hrudayam pongenu  (2)  

1. Ee lokham oka maayani telusukunnanu  
Yedhi na sontham kaadanukunnanu (2) 
Thapipoyina kumaruni nenaiyithe  
Na korakai neereekshinche thandri naa Yesu (2) 

2. Ae prema ne premaku saatiradayya  
Yenni unna Neetho sari-aedikaddaya (2) 
Nannu maruvani prema Needayya  
Nannu maarchukunna prema Neede Yesayya (2)

title: Nee Krupa Leni Kshanamu
lyrics:
Nee Krupa Leni Kshanamu 
Nee Daya Leni Kshanamu 
Nenoohinchalenu Yesayyaa (2) 
Yesayyaa Nee Krupa Naaku Chaalayyaa 
Nee Krupa Lenide Nenundalenayyaa (2)  

1. Mahimanu Vidichi Mahiloki Digi Vachchi 
Maargamugaa Maari Manishiga Maarchaavu 
Mahine Neevu Maadhuryamugaa Maarchi 
Maadiri Choopi Maro Roopamichchaavu (2) 
Mahimalo Nenu Mahimanu Ponda 
Mahimagaa Maarchindi Nee Krupa (2) 

2. Aagnala Maargamuna Aashrayamunu Ichchi 
Aapathkaalamuna Aadukonnaavu
Aathmeeyulatho Aanandimpa Chesi 
Aananda Thailamutho Abhishekinchaavu (2) 
Aasha Theera Aaraadhana Chese 
Arhathanichindi Nee Krupa (2)

title: Yahweh Neeve naa daivam
lyrics:
Bhayamu ledhu digule ledhu 
Naa jeevitham anthaa Prabhu chethilo 
Niraasha nannennadu muttaledhu 
Nireekshanatho anudinam saagedhanu 

Yahweh Neeve naa daivam 
Tarataramula varaku 
Yahweh Neeve naa aashrayam 
Tarataramula varaku 
Neevu kunukavu Neevu nidurapovu 
Israayelun kaapaaduvaadavu (2) 

1. Marana bhayam anthaa poyenu 
Shathru bheethi anthaa tholaginchenu (2) 
Maranamunu odinchi shathruvunu jayinchina 
Sarvaadhikaarivi naa devaa (2)

2. Otamini anthaa theesivesi 
Rogaanni anthaa maanpivese (2) 
Jayaseeludavu paramavaidhyudavu 
Sarvashakthudavu naa raakshaka (2)

title: Sumadhura Swaramula
lyrics:
Sumadhura Swaramula Gaanaalatho 
Velaadi Doothala Galamulatho 
Koniyaadabaduchunna Naa Yesayyaa 
Neeke Naa Aaraadhana (2) 
Mahadaanandame Naalo Paravashame 
Ninnu Sthuthinchina Prathikshanam (2)  

1. Edaari Throvalo Ne Nadachinaa 
Erugani Maargamulo Nanu Nadipinaa 
Naa Mundu Nadachina Jayaveerudaa 
Naa Vijaya Sankethamaa (2) 
Neeve Neeve Naa Aanandamu 
Neeve Neeve Naa Aadhaaramu 
Neeve Neeve Naa Aanandamu 
Neeve Naa Aadhaaramu 

2. Sampoornamaina Nee Chiththame 
Anukoolamaina Sankalpame 
Jariginchuchunnaavu Nanu Viduvaka 
Naa Dhairyamu Neevegaa (2) 
Neeve Neeve Naa Jayageethamu 
Neeve Neeve Naa Sthuthi Geethamu 
Neeve Neeve Naa Jayageethamu 
Neeve Naa Sthuthi Geethamu 

3. Velaadi Nadulanni Nee Mahimanu 
Tharangapu Pongulu Nee Balumunu 
Parvatha Shrenulu Nee Keerthine 
Prakatinchuchunnavegaa (2) 
Neeve Neeve Naa Athishayamu 
Neeke Neeke Naa Aaraadhana 
Neeve Neeve Naa Athishayamu 
Neeke Naa Aaraadhana

title: Yesu jananam sarvalokaniki shubhadinam
lyrics:
Yesu jananam sarva-lokaanike 
Shubhadinam shubha-karam (x2) 
Loka paapaan-ni mose gorrappillaga 
Ee lokaani karudhenchenu 
Nitya-jeevaanni icche raarajuga 
Goppa deevena techchenu 

Happy Happy Christmas 
Merry Merry Christmas (x2) 

Paapamu shaapamu nundi manalanu vidipimpanu 
Nitya-jeevamu icchutaku bhuvike ethenchenu (2) 

Mananento preminchenu 
Mana korakai ethanchenu 
Mana nento karuninchenu 
Mana korakai digivachchenu (x2)  

Gollalu jnaanulu ellaru poojinchiri 
Saagilapadi mrokki aanandamondiri (x2) 

Shubhavaartanu prakatinchiri 
Prabhu premanu chaatinchiri 
Ento santoshamondiri 
Saakshulai nilichiri (x2)

Paraloka sainyamu devuni stotrinchiri 
Paramandu doothalu pranuthinchi paadiri (x2) 

Prabhunento ghanaparachiri 
Prabhu mahimanu chaatiri 
Prabhunento poojinchiri 
Prabhunaaraadhinchinchiri

title: Ennil adanga sthothiram
lyrics:
Ennil adanga sthothiram - Deva
Endrendrum naan paaduven
Ennal varai en vazhvilae
Neer seitha nanmaikae

Countless thanks - Lord
I will sing all my days
Until this day in my life
For the goodness You’ve done

Vaanadhi vaananghal yaavum
Adhin keezhulla aahayamum
Bhoomiyil vazhghindra yaavum
Kartha ummai potrumae

All the Heavens above
And the sky below
Everything that lives on earth
Praises You Lord

Paava manukkulam yaavum
Um anbinai unarndhae
Siluvayin dhyagathai kandu
Oya thudhi paadudhae

Let all sinful mankind
Experience Your love
See the sacrifice on the cross
And sing endless praises

Bhoomiyil vazhghindra Yaavum
Adhin meluulla aahayamum
Vaan thoodhar seenaigal yaavum
Theva ummai potruthey

Everything that lives on Earth
And the skies above
All the heavenly hosts
Praise You O Lord
